label: BAD — Regulation 1 boilerplate (Diffuse Pollution 2018)
source_title: The Reduction and Prevention of Agricultural Diffuse Pollution (England) Regulations 2018
fragment_text: 1 These Regulations— a may be cited as the Reduction and Prevention of Agricultural Diffuse Pollution (England) Regulations 2018, b come into force on 2nd April 2018, c extend to England and Wales, and d apply to agricultural land in England.
why_this_case: Original failure mode: citation, commencement, extent, and application compressed or mis-tiered; application to agricultural land must not be treated as a generic operative duty.
